:::{#exm-precision-bernoulli}
#### Precision of a Bernoulli variable

If $\Outvar \sim \Ber(\prob)$ with $0 < \prob < 1$,
then $\Var{\Outvar} = \prob(1 - \prob)$,
so the [precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision) of $\Outvar$ is $\precision = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$.
:::
